verdict.rationale: The GeForce RTX 5070 Ti is a physical consumer graphics card that is installed in the buyer's own PC. Self-hosting versus vendor-hosting is a question for software and services, so this story is a category error for this product type. Claims about running AI models locally and privately describe workloads the GPU accelerates, not self-hosting of the core product, so they do not make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
